text: Then Nandi, having reached the door of the vine-covered house, with a golden staff tucked into the left side of his garment, led the group away, signaling with a finger over his lips, "Do not make a sound." The trees were motionless, the bird-calls were hushed, the bees were silent, and the herds of deer were still. Because of that command, the entire forest seemed to stand as if it were a painting.
